name: What permits do I need for a home extension in Glendale?

mainEntity.name: What permits do I need for a home extension in Glendale?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a home extension in Glendale, you will typically need several permits. These commonly include building permits, which cover structural integrity, safety, and general construction. Depending on the scope, you may also require electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits. Additionally, zoning approvals are often necessary to ensure the extension complies with local regulations regarding setbacks, height, and lot coverage. Opus Builders handles the entire permitting process, ensuring all necessary approvals are secured.
